name: Rasuwa flood
where: Rasuwa, Nuwakot, Dhading and downstream, Nepal
headline: Rasuwa flood, live
lede: A flash flood came down the Bhote Koshi from Tibet into Rasuwa on 26 August 2026. Here is what is confirmed, what is still unknown, and who to call.

stats.label: confirmed dead
stats.detail: Nepalnews: 1,342. Up from 1,294. Source: https://english.nepalnews.com/s/nation/bhote-koshi-flood-death-toll-reaches-1342-nearly-4900-still-missing/ Earlier note, 14:00 NPT, 30 August, describing a previous figure: Onlinekhabar: 1,114. Up from 768. Source: https://english.onlinekhabar.com/house-of-representatives-passes-special-resolution-on-rasuwa-floods.html

stats.label: listed missing in Nepal
stats.detail: Khabarhub: 8,898. Up from 5,083. Source: https://khabarhub.com/2026/04/1020594/ Earlier note, 10:00 NPT, 3 September, describing a previous figure: Nepalnews: 4,216 still unaccounted for, alongside 1,204 bodies recovered, in the same 2 September bulletin as the current toll. Source: https://nepalnews.com/ An earlier figure of 5,015 was published here; no bulletin supports it and it has been withdrawn.
stats.priorDetail: Nepalnews: 4,216 still unaccounted for, alongside 1,204 bodies recovered, in the same 2 September bulletin as the current toll. Source: https://nepalnews.com/ An earlier figure of 5,015 was published here; no bulletin supports it and it has been withdrawn.

stats.label: missing on the China side
stats.detail: Xinhua reports 546 people missing around Gyirong Port in Xizang (Tibet) as of 6pm Saturday, including 261 foreign nationals. Combined with Nepal's 2,502-person list that is 3,048 people unaccounted for across both countries, although the two countries' counts may overlap.

stats.label: rescued so far
stats.detail: Nepalnews: 12,038. Up from 11,993. Source: https://english.nepalnews.com/s/nation/bhote-koshi-flood-death-toll-reaches-1259/ Earlier note, 19:59 NPT, 2 September, describing a previous figure: NDRRMA's 1pm Sunday situation update reported 8,730 people rescued, Onlinekhabar reported. The report did not publish a current agency or location breakdown for that total, so no sub-rows are inferred.
stats.priorDetail: NDRRMA's 1pm Sunday situation update reported 8,730 people rescued, Onlinekhabar reported. The report did not publish a current agency or location breakdown for that total, so no sub-rows are inferred.

stats.label: hydropower projects damaged
stats.detail: The Nepal Electricity Authority reports 14 projects damaged with a combined capacity of about 748 MW: 9 operating plants (354 MW) and 5 under construction (394 MW). Named ones include Rasuwagadhi, Chilime, Sanjen Khola, Upper Trishuli-1, Trishuli and Devighat, plus a 220 kV substation. An earlier same-day Ministry of Energy estimate said 431 MW.

stats.label: since the flood
stats.detail: Counting from the morning of 26 August 2026, when the flood hit. Search, rescue and recovery work is still going on this many days later.

stats.label: damage, early estimate
stats.detail: Physical Infrastructure Minister Sunil Lamsal put damage to roads and bridges at about Rs 200 billion on 26 August, and called it preliminary. Hydropower and private property are not in that figure. The whole 42 km road from Betrawati to the Rasuwagadhi border crossing was destroyed at multiple points.

stats.label: relief fund deposited
stats.detail: Prime Minister Balen Shah said Rs 5.04 billion had been deposited in nine commercial bank accounts for flood rescue and relief, Onlinekhabar reported at 9:04pm Saturday. The same report said another US$1.8 million was deposited at Himalayan Bank and Laxmi Bank. This is money deposited in the fund, not the separate Rs 1 billion released by the government.
